home_meta_title: PadelIndex — Your level. Proven, not claimed.
home_meta_description: PadelIndex is the independent rating for amateur padel players. A Bayesian rating built for doubles, confirmed by your opponents, valid across every club. Try the match simulator to see how your rating moves.
home_og_description: A padel doubles rating from confirmed matches: opponent strength, score margin and confidence — not self-assessment.
home_hero_eyebrow: The rating for amateur padel players
home_hero_sub: PadelIndex measures how strong you really play — across club lines, from confirmed results, with a model built for doubles instead of chess.
home_problem_h2: Almost nobody really knows their level.
home_problem_p: Levels get guessed, ticked on a form, or handed out differently by every club. The moment you play somewhere else, the number means nothing. But the most common objection to a rating system checks out on paper — here it is.
home_gripe1_q: "I've clearly gotten better — the number just won't move."
home_gripe1_a: With PadelIndex your rating moves after every confirmed match, and you see exactly how much of that came from opponent strength, score margin, and your recent run.
home_gripe2_q: "That guy only plays in his own circle and suddenly he's at the top."
home_gripe2_a: Every result needs confirmation from the opposing team. Results without an opponent don't count — so made-up matches don't either.
home_gripe3_q: "Won 6:1, 6:2 and the rating didn't move at all. I don't get it."
home_gripe3_a: That's why we show the math: after every match, you see exactly what changed and why — even when the number doesn't feel right.
home_rating_p: No questionnaire, no guessed value: PadelIndex calculates from opponent strength, score margin and confirmation by the opposing team — with the exact same code that runs the live ratings. Try the rating simulator yourself.
home_tokens_p: You earn tokens for every confirmed match. Redeem them at your club — for coaching sessions, equipment, or entry fees. Like frequent-flyer miles, just for padel.
home_vereine_h2: The rating runs on your own site.
home_vereine_p_pre: From here on it's not about your own level anymore, it's about your club — if you're only here as a player right now,
home_vereine_p_post: above is already everything you need. For clubs: one line of code, and the ranking runs on your website, in your colors, with zero plugin chaos.
home_liga_h2: Real club leagues run on PadelIndex too.
home_liga_p: The BÁVARO PADEL LEAGUE at STC Oberland plays in 4-player boxes with rotating doubles partners, its own box standings and promotion/relegation — a standalone ranking alongside the general PadelIndex level. Results also feed into the Index rating.
home_ratgeber_h2: Rules, equipment, technique and tactics, explained simply.
home_ratgeber_p: The PadelIndex guides cover everything from your first serve to doubles tactics — and the quiz, with three difficulty levels, lets you test how confident you really are.
home_cta_p: We're starting in the Oberland region. Sign up and we'll reach out once your club is on board — or we'll ask them for you.
hseq_note: Calculated with the model that runs in production — opponent strength, score margin, and how well the system already knows you.
rating_meta_title: How the PadelIndex rating is calculated — a level from confirmed matches
rating_meta_description: No questionnaire, no self-assessment: PadelIndex calculates your padel level from opponent strength, score margin and confidence — with the exact same model that rates every match in production. Try the rating simulator.
rating_og_title: How the PadelIndex rating is calculated
rating_og_description: A level from confirmed matches instead of self-assessment: opponent strength, score margin and confidence, explained clearly.
rating_intro_p: Turn the values and hit calculate. It's computed with the exact same code that runs the live ratings — including the doubles logic: the less the system knows someone, the more their rating moves. Set a player's match count to zero and watch.
rating_factor1_p: A win against a stronger duo says more than one against a weaker one. Surprises carry the most information, so they weigh the most.
rating_factor2_p: 6:0, 6:0 is a different statement than 7:6, 5:7, 7:5. The score margin factors into every calculation — a close loss against strong opponents costs you almost nothing.
rating_factor3_p: Your rating swings a lot at first, on purpose: after roughly ten to fifteen matches your range settles. After that, it's just fine-tuning.
rating_cta1_pre: That was just the simulation — your real level needs a real match.
rating_cta2_pre: Not sure yet roughly where you stand?
rating_sicherheit_h2: The more you play, the more precise your level gets.
rating_sicherheit_p: We don't store a single number for you, but a distribution: an estimate of your ability plus the uncertainty around it. What's shown is deliberately the cautious edge — if you've played little, you'd rather be underestimated than overestimated.
rating_verlauf_p: Not a drawn graph: these fourteen matches ran one after another through the real model — from the first entry as an unknown player to the end of the provisional phase.

faq_meta_title: Frequently asked questions about PadelIndex — FAQ
faq_meta_description: Answers about PadelIndex: how the level is calculated, how clubs can join, what it costs, and who's behind it.
faq_og_description: How the level is calculated, how clubs can join, what it costs, and who's behind it.
faq_intro_pre: Answers about level, clubs, and everything around them. Missing something?
faq_a1: PadelIndex is an independent rating platform for amateur padel players in Germany. Your level comes from confirmed matches — opponent strength, score margin, and how confident we already are in your level — not from a questionnaire.
faq_a2: For anyone who wants to know how strong they really play. Whether you're just starting out, play regularly at your club, or run a club and want a ranking on your website.
faq_a3: From every confirmed match: who you beat, how clear-cut it was, and how many matches we already know about you. The rating simulator at /rating calculates with the exact same code that runs in production.
faq_a4: Yes. We're onboarding clubs one at a time — STC Oberland is currently our pilot club. If your club wants in, you can request a demo at /vereine.
faq_q5: How do I report incorrect information?
faq_a5: If a result is attributed incorrectly or a profile isn't yours, write to us at kontakt@padelindex.de. For your own profile, there's also an "I don't want to be listed here" link directly on the profile page that works without logging in.
faq_a6: For players, yes, always. For clubs there's a free tier plus two paid plans with more features — details at /vereine.
faq_a7: PadelIndex is developed by Alec Hahn, part of the family business Sportcenter Hahn GmbH, active in sports facilities and sports operations for many years. More at /ueber.
faq_q8: Is PadelIndex affiliated with a padel federation?
faq_a8: No. PadelIndex is an independent platform, not tied to any federation or league.
faq_q9: Can I manage my club myself?
faq_a9: Yes — as a club admin you can already manage members, approve profile claims, and set up a rewards catalog, directly in your own club area.
faq_a10: Levels are usually guessed or ticked on a questionnaire — and then only valid within one club or app. PadelIndex instead calculates from real, confirmed results, across clubs.
faq_a11: Your level updates with every confirmed match. Where a ranking still relies on imported league results, we say so openly with a notice instead of faking a date that suggests it's current.
faq_a12: The simplest way: play, report your matches, give us feedback. The more confirmed results come together, the more accurate the rating gets for everyone.
faq_q13: How can I get in touch?
faq_a13: By email at kontakt@padelindex.de — we appreciate any feedback that helps make PadelIndex better.

ueber_meta_description: PadelIndex is a project by Alec Hahn (Sportcenter Hahn GmbH) — a rating for amateur padel players from confirmed matches, no questionnaire and no club directory.
ueber_og_description: A rating for amateur padel players from confirmed matches — who's behind PadelIndex and why it exists.
ueber_h1: Orientation for the growing padel community.
ueber_intro_p1: PadelIndex is a platform for everyone who plays padel in Germany and wants to know how strong they really are.
ueber_intro_p2: Our goal is simple: a level built from real, confirmed matches — not from self-assessment or a number that never moves. From your own rating to your club's ranking to the question of how you'd really stack up against a specific team — PadelIndex aims to be the go-to place for your level in German padel.
ueber_praxis_h2: From the field, for the field
ueber_praxis_p1: Behind PadelIndex is Alec Hahn, developer and part of the family business Sportcenter Hahn GmbH.
ueber_praxis_p2: The Hahn family has worked in operating and developing sports facilities for decades. Sportcenter Hahn connects sport, club life, and professional sports infrastructure, giving direct insight into what players and clubs actually need.
ueber_praxis_p3: To us, padel is more than just another trend sport. The dynamism, the community, and the sport's rapid growth in Germany hold enormous potential — but also raise the question of how to compare your own level across club boundaries at all. PadelIndex aims to solve exactly that: a rating that's explainable and grows with every match.
ueber_anspruch_p1: We don't want to build a complicated rating system, but one that's trusted.
ueber_claim_line1: Play. Confirm. Know where you stand.
ueber_value_nachvollziehbarkeit_t: every change to your level is explained, no black box.
ueber_value_bestaetigung_t: a result only counts once the opposing team agrees.
ueber_value_transparenz_t: the same code in the rating simulator as in production.
ueber_value_community_t: a rating lives from the players and clubs who take part.
ueber_value_wachstum_t: we grow with every club that joins.
ueber_gemeinsam_p1: Padel is growing fast in Germany. At the same time, almost no club has a reliable way to place its members' level beyond its own courts. That's exactly where PadelIndex comes in.
ueber_gemeinsam_p2: We're starting with a pilot club in the Oberland region (STC Oberland) and want to grow from there — club by club, match by match.
ueber_gemeinsam_p3_pre: If you represent a club that wants to join, spot an error in your profile, or have an idea for the platform, we'd love to hear from you at
ueber_claim_line2: Padel is growing. We make your level visible.
ds_p2: PadelIndex processes two kinds of personal data: the email address you provide when joining the waitlist or registering, and the public ranking data of padel players (name or abbreviated name, level, match results). Both are described separately below.
ds_p3: This website runs on Cloudflare Workers. Cloudflare necessarily processes technical connection data (including IP address, time of access, requested page) in order to deliver the website at all. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in stable, secure operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). This access data is not linked to ranking or account data.
ds_p4_intro: We use the following external services, which act as processors on our behalf:
ds_p4_supabase_desc: (database, login) — stores all account, ranking, and match data.
ds_p4_supabase_status: Server location and status of the data processing agreement: to be added.
ds_p4_cloudflare_desc: (hosting, delivery) — delivers the website and processes technical connection data for that purpose (see section 3).
ds_p4_cloudflare_status: Legal basis for the data transfer: to be added.
ds_p4_resend_desc: (transactional emails) — sends emails on our behalf that are necessary for operation (e.g. confirmation links, notifications about play requests and challenges). Resend receives the email address and content of each message for that purpose.
ds_p5_pre: If you join the waitlist on padelindex.de, we store your email address and, if provided, your club's name, in order to inform you about the start of the pilot and to reach out to your club directly. The entry only becomes active once you click the confirmation link in the email (double opt-in) — until then, the address is only provisionally noted. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw this consent at any time, informally, by email to
ds_p5_post: ; we then delete the entry immediately.
ds_p6: If a club requests a demo via the form in the clubs area, we store the club name, contact person, email address, and an optional message in order to process the request. The legal basis is the initiation of a contractual relationship (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
ds_p7_1: At the core of PadelIndex is a publicly viewable ranking per club: name (or abbreviated for profiles not yet claimed, e.g. "Robin K."), level value, number of matches, and a rough form trend.
ds_p7_2_bold: registered players who signed up themselves
ds_p7_2_post: the processing for providing the ranking is part of contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) — anyone who registers does so explicitly in order to appear in a ranking.
ds_p7_3_post: and have not yet been claimed by the person concerned, no consent yet exists. Here we rely on our legitimate interest in making existing league results visible and comparable (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) — for this reason, these names are always shown abbreviated only, never in full. You can object to this at any time (Art. 21 GDPR, see section 9) — your profile then disappears from the public view, without needing an account to do so.
ds_p8: We use only technically necessary cookies to keep you logged in after signing in (Supabase Auth session cookie). There are currently no analytics, marketing, or tracking cookies and no advertising networks on this site.
ds_p9: We store account and ranking data for as long as your account or profile exists. We store waitlist entries until the pilot launches or until you withdraw. After a deletion or a successful objection (sections 6 and 9), we remove the affected data from public view immediately; complete removal from backups happens as part of the usual backup cycles.
ds_p10_intro: You have the right, at any time, to:
ds_p10_1_pre: access to the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR), correction of inaccurate data (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), data portability (Art. 20 GDPR), and objection to processing based on legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR). For your own public player profile, you'll find a direct "I don't want to be listed here" link on your profile page that works without logging in. For anything else, an email to
ds_p10_2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The authority responsible for us is the Bavarian State Office for Data Protection Supervision (BayLDA).
ds_p11: Transmission between your browser and our servers is TLS-encrypted throughout (https). Access to account data and non-public profile data is restricted via access rules (Row Level Security) at the database level.
